translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Kaliva yana tubuga againe givematakoyo-ma
Yesu gikiveyamumuna.
Tova saꞋeyana ime Yesu ana tomuliya Bana buye anunudadana tu tomatakoyo saꞋeyana aꞋitana, yana tubuga againe givematakoyo.
Ada Yesu atoliluveluvena agayo, “Tovehawala, gavana faꞋina hida kaliva yana tubuga againe givematakoyo? KaꞋi bana tauna yana koyona faꞋina, o kaꞋi tamana hinana yadi koyona faꞋina givematakoyo?”

Bana Yesu gigayo, “Keke tauna yana koyona faꞋina, kadu keke tamana hinana yadi koyona faꞋina hida kaliva gidavematakoyo. Tu Yaubada yana faiwala bana yana yamumu againe ginaseyemaunena faꞋina givematakoyo.
Au aimo uyadayada againe gilubodada be Bana giꞋiveniniseku-ma yana faisewa kanafaisewa. Uyuyu giyemuyemu ada uyuyu againe kaliva keke anafaiweya ginafaisewa.
Iya aimo babiya gamimiyami ana toveya, Iya omi tomiyababi yami mahala, nuwami gakikivemahalina.”

Au hidede amine gigahe-yo babiya gikiwala, kiwalina againe babi gikiꞋamoꞋamona maikawa amine, au tomatakoyo matana againe babi fwalelena giseni tu gigahena gigayo, “Unana niꞋu ana egana Sailomu againe mata unakolana.” Ime bonameya Sailomu ana kaivila ma iveꞋiveninitana. Ada au kaliva gilowoga matana gikolana giyewana matana giꞋitaꞋitalele.
Tu yana yoꞋo kadu badi boi yana vematakoyo tova moyaꞋaina hiꞋitaꞋitana, medema higahegahe higayo, “Hida kaꞋi kaliva edeya gihiyoto be mani faꞋina giveꞋoveꞋoꞋola-ma, o kaꞋi mali kaliva?”

Kadu tufoidi higayo, “Makewa bana hida kalivai-nadi.” Ada kadu tufoidi higayo, “Au keke banaꞋe tu ana bela tomatakoyo ana bela amine.” Tu bana kaliva tauna gigahegahe gigayo, “VelemoꞋena iya kalivai-kuna.”
Au badi higahe-faꞋila higayo, “GavaiyaꞋamine uyamumu-yo mata giꞋitaꞋitalele?”

Bana kaliva gigayo, “Kaliva saꞋeyana, ana egana Yesu, babi gikiꞋamoꞋamona be matakuya giseni tu gigaheku gigayo, Unana Sailomu niꞋu againe mata unakolana. Ada au gana gakola-yo gayamumu, mataku givebutu giꞋitalele.”
Ada badi higayo, “Bana kalivai-nadi hami gina?” Bana gigayo, “Iya keke gadahalamaneni.”
Tonagona tafatafalolodiyao adi egana Falisi
tomatakoyo hitoliluveluvena.
Tu tomatakoyo giyamumu-ma, Falisi agaidiya hinauwena.
FaꞋina sabati againe veyawai ana tova tu Yesu babi gikiꞋamoꞋamona be kaliva matane giseni-yo, au gikiyauna.

Au Falisi kaliva againe kadu hitoliluvaluva higayo, “GavaiyaꞋamine uyamumu? GavaiꞋona-yo mata giꞋitaꞋitalele?” Bana kaliva gigayo, “Babi fwalelena matakuya giseni tu gakolana, ada au mataku giꞋitaꞋitalele.”

Ada Falisi tufoidi higahegahe higayo, “Hida hima kaliva keke-moꞋa Yaubada gidaꞋiveniniseni, faꞋina sabati ana vehimeya keke gidaꞋabiꞋabini.” Tu kadu tufoidi higahegahe higayo, “KaꞋi hida kaliva velemoꞋena tokoyona digo, hida iyaꞋiyaya fifiwalana tomatakoyo againe keke anafaiweya gidafaisewani.” Ada au Falisi buye hiveꞋatolitoli, yadi nuwanuwa tulina tulina.
Kadu tomatakoyo againe hitoliluvaluva-havagi higayo, “O ugahe vaita hida kaliva mata gidakiyauni. Au bana faꞋine gavaimi unuwanuwa?” Ada bana tomatakoyo gigayo, “Au Bana Yaubada yana kaliva.”
Tu badi miYuda hivaita kaliva matana keke velemoꞋena gidakoyo-yo gidayamumu, faꞋina kaliva tamana hinana hiyowanidi be hiꞋela.

HiꞋela-yo hitoliluveluvedi higayo, “KaꞋi bana hidevama omi natumi? Omi wagahe vaita yana tubuga againe gidavematakoyo. KaꞋi tuwaina matana keke gidaꞋitaꞋitalele tu gavadi-yo adamoya matana giꞋitalele?”
Au kaliva tamana hinana higahedi higayo, “Bana hidevama ime natuma amanadi ahalamane-moꞋena. KaduꞋe gitubuga againe makewa matana keke gidaꞋitaꞋitalele.

Atu gavadi-yo matana adamoya giyamumu ma keke adahalamaneni, o kaꞋi hakwadi matana gikiyauna be giꞋitaꞋitalele keke adahalamaneni. Au bana tauna againe wanatoliluvaluva. Bana a givekaliva-lakata faꞋina, tauna faꞋine anafaiweya ginahawavemogatala.”

Kaliva tamana hinana miYuda yama tonagona higa himatausedi be hidede amine higahe. FaꞋina miYuda ahe hivehimeya, kaꞋi tamo hakwadi Yesu faꞋine ginagahe vaita Bana Yaubada yana Tovegida Keliso digo, bana kalivai-nadi ana egana hinayawelina be keke anafaiweya manuwa-abavehawala sinagogi againe ginaluku-yo ginatafalolo.
Hida vehimeya faꞋina tomatakoyo tamana hinana higahe higayo, “Bana againe wanatoliluvaluva, ahe givekaliva-lakata faꞋina.”

Au tova anavelu tomatakoyo giyamumu-ma hiyowanina, higahena higayo, “Ya yamumu faꞋina Yaubada ana egana unakilakahina. Wadema kalivai-nadi ahalamanena Bana wadevama tokoyona faꞋina keke unahawadavadavani.”
Tu tomatakoyo gigahedi gigayo, “Iya keke gadahalamaneni kaꞋi Bana tokoyona o kaꞋi keke. Tu gaitoma saꞋeyana iya gahalamane-moꞋena, higa boi mataku gikoyo-vagata tu adamoya mataku giꞋitaꞋitalele.”
Ada au badi higayo, “Gavadi o againiya gigani? GavaiyaꞋamine mata gikiyauni?”
Bana gigayo, “Ahe gagahemi tu keke wadavenogaleku. Gavana faꞋina nuwanuwami ganagaheye-havagileni? KaꞋi omi nuwanuwami Bana againe kadu wanavetomuliya, kaꞋi keke?”
Gigahe-yo au hifainena higayo, “OꞋeni wada kaliva ana tomuliya tu imeꞋeyao ma Mosese yana vehawala amulimuliyena.
Yaubada Mosese againe gilukahihi ma ahalamanena tu wama kaliva ma inubana keke adahalamaneni.”
Tu bana tomatakoyo gihawavelaigedi gigayo, “A! Keke fwaya. Mataku gikiyauna faꞋina, vaita inubana wadahalamaneni.
Ide moyaꞋaida kahalamanena Yaubada tokoyona keke gidavelugadi tu hai kaliva saꞋeyana Yaubada gimatausena bonana giꞋabiꞋabina, medema Yaubada givelugana be gugai fifiwalana anafaiweya ginafaisewana.
Boi tuwai-moꞋena kadu adamoya keke tamo hakwadi valeyana kadanogalini, vaita kaliva yana tubuga againe givematakoyo amanadi gidakiveyamumuni.
KaꞋi hida kaliva wavekwageyena-ma keke Yaubada gidaꞋiveniniseni, kadu keke anafaiweya gugai fifiwalana gidafaisewani.” Hidemi tomatakoyo gigahe.
Au badi miYuda higayo, “O tokoyona, ya koyona faꞋina utubukoyo, mata keke gidaꞋitalele. O tokoyona nonogana, uhuluva vaita halamana unavehawalema.” Ada au hiwavina be gina.
Kaliva aseꞋaseda yana vematakoyo faꞋina.
Tu badi hiwavina ma Yesu ginogalina. Ginogalini-yo gina gilelena ginuhagana, ada gitoliluveluvena gigayo, “KaꞋi Bana TohobuꞋela uvetumaganena?”
Bana kaliva tomatakoyo gigayo, “Kauveya, Bana TohobuꞋela hakwaꞋadi? Unahawavetuvetunuku be ganavetumaganena faꞋina.”
Bana Yesu gigayo, “Ahe uꞋitana. Iya kaliva buye kalulukahihi-ma Kalivai-kuna.”
Ada bana tomatakoyo gigayo, “Kauveya iya gavetumagane.” Ada au Yesu againe giꞋodu ada gidavadavana.
Tu Yesu gigayo, “Iya babiya gahobuꞋela be kaliva yadi nuwanuwa aseꞋasediya ganakivemogatalina. Badi matadi uyuꞋuyuyuna ganakivemahalidi, tu badi hivaita matadi mahamahalina medema hinavematakoyo.”
Ada Falisi tufoidi Bana liline himiyami-ma yana gahe hinogalina ada higahena higayo, “KaꞋi O uvaita ime kadu matama gidaꞋuyuyuni.”
Yesu gigahedi gigayo, “KaꞋi omi fanifanimiyao digo, keke ami wavita. Tu omi wagahe vaita matami mahamahalina faꞋina, ami wavita wamimiyami.” Hidemi Yesu Falisi gigahedi.
